content: Bearable: rotate phone to landscape on Insights tab for a comparison graph; plot Mood/Symptoms/Energy vs Sleep, water, steps, HR, custom measurements via buttons below the chart; Factors (incl. medication) highlight days via 'Select Factor' button — binary factors shown as day-highlights, not lines. Correlations need >=3 days with and >=3 without a factor; 30-day tracking recommended; premium shows % effect of factor on mood/symptoms/sleep. Guava: per-symptom detail charts toggle frequency/severity and time period; 'Compare' button overlays other symptoms/metrics; insights find co-occurring symptoms and metric relationships. Clue: cycle-length line chart of last 6 cycles vs ACOG range; analysis tools (Feelings Analysis, Cycle History). Flo: Graphs & Reports with cycle duration charts. Neither Clue nor Flo offers free-form multi-series overlay; Bearable/Guava are the comparators.
